from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 4
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in cuts:
            if start < x: out.append((start,x))
            start=x+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs=spans(h,row_cuts); cs=spans(w,col_cuts)
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    tiles=[]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            vals=[(r-r0,c-c0,grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] not in (sep,bg)]
            if vals: tiles.append((r1-r0,c1-c0,vals))
    if not tiles: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    th,tw,pattern=tiles[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            if r1-r0 != th or c1-c0 != tw: continue
            for dr,dc,v in pattern:
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=v
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-00cbe9fd.py'; p.write_text(code)
